Engineering Mathematics: Discrete mathematics: logic, sets, relations, functions, partial orders, lattices, groups
Combinatorics: counting, recurrence relations, generating functions, graph theory
Linear algebra: matrices, determinants, systems of linear equations, eigenvalues, eigenvectors
Calculus: limits, continuity, differentiability, maxima and minima, integration
Probability and statistics: random variables, distributions, expectation, variance, conditional probability
Digital Logic: Combinational circuits: arithmetic circuits, code converters, multiplexers, decoders
Sequential circuits: latches, flip-flops, counters, registers
Computer Organization and Architecture: Memory hierarchy: cache, main memory, secondary storage
Programming and Data Structures: Programming in C: pointers, arrays, functions, recursion, structures, unions
Trees, binary search trees, heaps, balanced trees
Algorithms: Divide and conquer, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming
Graph algorithms: traversal, shortest paths, minimum spanning trees
Compiler Design: Syntax-directed translation and intermediate code generation
Computer Networks: Data link layer: framing, error detection, MAC, Ethernet
Network layer: IP, addressing, routing, IPv4, IPv6
Transport layer: TCP, UDP, congestion control
